verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno.
verses.english: Now at that time the Buddha had gone into retreat for the day’s meditation.

verses.pali: Atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā paccekaṁ dvārabāhaṁ nissāya aṭṭhaṁsu.
verses.english: Then the independent divinities Subrahmā and Suddhāvāsa went to the Buddha and stationed themselves one by each door-post.

verses.pali: Atha kho suddhāvāso paccekabrahmā katamodakatissakaṁ bhikkhuṁ ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then Suddhāvāsa spoke this verse about the mendicant Katamorakatissaka in the Buddha’s presence:
I think anyone who’d do such a thing
is an ignoramus, shrouded in darkness.”
